name: ilovelocalpdf
description: All PDF tools running locally in your browser via Rust + WebAssembly

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir www/pkg && rm -rf docs/pkg && cp -R www/pkg docs/pkg
scripts.build:pages: node scripts/generate-tool-pages.mjs && cp -R www/js www/css www/robots.txt www/pkg www/sitemap.xml docs/
scripts.build:all: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:pages
